Across both sessions, the team trained him on critical lead response protocols emphasizing the five-minute contact standard, demonstrated communication centralization including calls, texts, emails and recordings, and reviewed automatic syncing from Housecall Pro and Lesson Pro with color-coded technician scheduling. A major pipeline cleanup was planned to delete over 1,400 opportunities dated before July 1 to streamline focus on recent leads, with an expected 5-10% re-engagement rate. Technical issues were identified including a Lesson Pro email forwarding problem that broke job syncing after July 7, requiring resolution with Xavier.
action_items: Accept Go High Level account invitation and confirm notification settings for new leads and missed calls to ensure timely follow-up.
Delete all opportunity records prior to July 1 while retaining contacts from July 1 onward to reduce clutter and improve focus on recent leads.
Contact leads quickly, preferably within first 5 minutes of submission, moving them to appropriate statuses in the pipeline.
